name: The Blue Skies of Milan
source:
There were once two boys, two best friends, who swore to always stay together and support each other's hearts. It is under the endlessness of the Milanese skies that the two boys agree to change the world, together.

But there is a tragic twist.

[From [url=https://chimeriquement.itch.io/the-blue-skies-of-milan]itch.io[/url]]

A fangame of the anime "Romeo's Blue Skies".
